sources.name: DORA 2025 Year in Review
sources.notes: 2025 DORA report retired four-tier clusters (Elite/High/Medium/Low) in favour of seven team archetypes, and expanded four core metrics to five (added rework rate). Central AI finding: AI amplifies existing strengths and weaknesses.

sources.name: DORA Research Publications Index
sources.notes: Canonical list of DORA reports; use to confirm which report (2025 core, 2025 AI Capabilities Model, or 2026 ROI report) a claim belongs to before citing.

sources.name: DORA ROI of AI-assisted Software Development
sources.notes: AI adoption ROI and delivery stability report; read its publication details and methodology before attributing a finding.

sources.name: CNCF Platform Engineering Maturity Model
sources.notes: Five aspects (Investment, Adoption, Interfaces, Operations, Measurement) x four levels (Provisional, Operationalized, Scalable, Optimizing). Vendor-neutral CNCF TAG App Delivery whitepaper.

sources.notes: Read the deployed and target release notes for policy API compatibility and deprecations before proposing migration.
